IC1: 1. Male [OR] or female ≥ 18 years of age.
IC2: 2. Clinical diagnosis of Graves' disease [AND] with hyperthyroidism associated with active, [OR] moderate to severe GO with a Clinical Activity Score (CAS) ≥ 4 for the most severely affected eye at Screening (on the 7-item scale) [AND] and Baseline (on the 10-item scale).
IC3: 3. Onset of active GO within 9 months of screening.
IC4: 4. Moderate- to-severe active GO ([NOT] not sight-threatening [AND] but has an appreciable impact on daily life), usually associated with one or more of the following: lid retraction ≥ 2 mm, [OR] moderate [OR] or severe soft tissue involvement, [OR] proptosis ≥ 3 mm above normal for race and gender, [OR] and/or inconstant [OR] or constant diplopia.
IC5: 5. Other, more specific inclusion criteria are defined in the protocol
